gaps.sentence: The plane was delayed; ___, we missed the connection.
The old system charged per download, ___ the new one uses a flat monthly fee.
gaps.explanation: 'Whereas' sets the old and new systems side by side.

gaps.sentence: She missed the deadline; ___, her application was rejected.
gaps.explanation: Missing the deadline caused the rejection: as a result introduces the outcome.

gaps.sentence: He neither apologised ___ offered an explanation.
gaps.explanation: 'Neither' pairs with 'nor' in this correlative structure.

gaps.sentence: He didn't whisper the news; ___, he announced it to the whole office.
gaps.explanation: 'On the contrary' corrects the first statement with its opposite.

gaps.sentence: ___ had I closed my eyes than the alarm went off.
gaps.explanation: The 'than' in the sentence forces 'No sooner', the only linker paired with than.

gaps.sentence: The treatment doesn't weaken patients; ___, it speeds up their recovery.
gaps.explanation: 'On the contrary' asserts the opposite of what was just said.

gaps.sentence: No sooner had the applause died ___ the encore began.
gaps.explanation: 'No sooner... than' is invariable; 'when' would be wrong here.
